The walk ends when Rik arrives in a hoop he has already visited. The length of the walk is the number of hoops he has visited along the way.

Give a numbering of the ${n}$ hoops such that the length of the walk is ${k}$.

This sequence ensures that Rik visits each hoop exactly once before returning to a hoop he has already visited, thus achieving a walk length of 25.
